related_questions.question: Does the American Cancer Society provide free wigs?

text_blocks.snippet: Yes, the American Cancer Society (ACS) provides free wigs to adult women experiencing hair loss due to cancer treatment. They offer these wigs through their Gift Closets and other local offices. Additionally, the ACS provides resources for finding other free or low-cost wigs and headwear through programs like EverYou™.
How to access free wigs from the American Cancer Society:

list.title: Contact a local ACS office or Gift Closet:
list.snippet: Many ACS offices and Gift Closets have free wigs available for patients who qualify.

list.title: Inquire about appointments:
list.snippet: Some locations may require appointments to be fitted for a free wig.

list.title: Consider online resources:
list.snippet: The ACS website, such as the EverYou™ program, offers curated selections of quality wigs, headwear, and scarves.

list.title: Explore other support programs:
list.snippet: The ACS also offers programs like Road To Recovery for rides to treatment and lodging options near treatment centers.

list.title: Look for online fundraising options:
list.snippet: If you need financial assistance, online fundraising can help you raise funds for wigs and other medical expenses, according to an article on AngeLink.
